views.rationale: Revenue rose to $72,786 million from $69,235 million (≈5% YoY) while operating margin held at 10.7% versus 10.6% in 2017

Revenue grew 21% YoY (22% in constant currency) to $33.7 billion, indicating strong momentum into the next quarter
